hold_text: Stacked on #25000 (SEC-DETECTORS D1, Tier 2, awaiting the manager's merge); this branch carries #25000's commits, so it must land after #25000. Tier 2 as well: it changes what ict-security-watch.service does on the live VM. Manager merges after #25000. Post-merge checks: journalctl?unit=ict-security-watch shows a 'files' object in each run's JSON line with unreadable=0 (or the alert ledger holds ONE 'cannot read' flag naming the paths), and the alert ledger holds ONE '[INFO] ... file baseline recorded' row and no file '[RED FLAG]' rows across the next pull-and-deploy.
why: SEC-DETECTORS D3: adds a 'files' detector to scripts/ops/security_watch.py. It hashes authorized_keys (every home plus /root), /etc/sudoers and sudoers.d, unit files and drop-ins under /etc/systemd/system, /etc/crontab, /etc/cron.d and the user crontabs, and alerts once per change through telegram_channels.send('alert') and the alert ledger, deduplicated by alert_cooldown. Alerts name the path only, never the content. A unit equal to deploy/<name>, or a drop-in equal to a deploy/ file, is expected and silent. Unreadable paths keep their old hash and raise one alert when the set grows. Reads only; no gate, no halt; always exits 0.
